sets.relationshipLabel: a role or resource produces a branded functional artifact
sets.explanation: A coach designs the playbook a team runs, just as a sponsor's backing produces the jersey players wear.

sets.relationshipLabel: a supportive or disruptive play creates a scoring/transition opportunity
sets.explanation: A screen clears space for an open shot, and a steal flips defense into offense by sparking a fast break — different plays, same pattern of manufacturing opportunity.

sets.relationshipLabel: a rule-defined event forces a mandatory game continuation
sets.explanation: A foul automatically sends a player to the line for a free throw, just as a tied buzzer forces the game into overtime — both are the rulebook mandating extra play.

sets.relationshipLabel: a negative game circumstance forces a player off the active court
sets.explanation: An injury sidelines a player to the bench, and a lopsided blowout does the same for starters, clearing the floor for bench players — both circumstances push someone out of active play.
